text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Dramas about chasing UFOs and cryptids... 
Even if it's fiction, you can get "totally 
hooked."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Binge-watching" multiple series... Next 
thing I knew, "Daybreak"— I am "INTI", but 
"sleep-deprived"...

Neo Universe got so absorbed in a drama 
series that she didn't seem to get much 
rest...
